resources.string: Android forgets the pairing after 7 days without a USB connection, and then calls stop being recorded until you pair again. CallVault can switch that time limit off.
This also keeps any computer you allowed for USB debugging allowed. You can switch this off again in Settings ▸ Connection ▸ Stay paired for good.
Stops Android forgetting the pairing after 7 days without a USB connection.
Could not change the limit. The pairing can still expire.
Something else turned the limit off, so CallVault leaves it alone.
If CallVault was paired more than 7 days ago over Wi-Fi, Android may forget the pairing right away and calls won\'t be recorded until you pair again.
The limit was changed elsewhere, so CallVault left it as it is.
